name: Typographic Portfolio Hero
purpose: Establish identity, specialty, and visual tone with expressive typography.
compositionNotes: Use large type but preserve mobile readability.

name: Selected Work Grid
purpose: Showcase multiple projects with strong visual rhythm.
compositionNotes: Vary card sizes and aspect ratios intentionally.

name: Featured Case Study
purpose: Give one project premium attention and narrative context.
compositionNotes: Use after selected-work grid or as the first proof section.

name: Horizontal Marquee Proof
purpose: Create motion rhythm with services, clients, awards, or capabilities.
compositionNotes: Use motion sparingly; content must remain understandable.

name: Process Narrative
purpose: Explain creative process as a story.
compositionNotes: Use editorial spacing, not boxed step cards.

name: Image-led About
purpose: Humanize the studio/person behind the work.
compositionNotes: Make the image meaningful; avoid stock-like atmosphere.

name: Awards and Recognition List
purpose: Show credibility through awards, press, or client outcomes.
compositionNotes: Use clean rows with strong typography.

name: Project Inquiry CTA
purpose: Close with a clear collaboration invitation.
compositionNotes: Keep the close confident and minimal.
